title: Special Conditions: Articles 705-780
briefing: Special occupancies and conditions — NEC Articles 705 through 780. Ten questions, 70% to pass.

questions.prompt: Equipment is used to interconnect an electric power production source with another power source. What approval does the NEC require for this equipment?
choices: It must be listed for the intended use
It only needs a field-applied voltage label
It may be unlisted when installed indoors
It must be approved only by the serving utility
questions.explanation: Equipment used to interconnect electric power production sources must be listed for the intended use.

questions.prompt: An interconnected power production source is provided with a disconnecting means. What must the disconnecting means do when operated?
choices: Simultaneously disconnect all ungrounded conductors of the source
Disconnect only the grounded conductor
Disconnect one ungrounded conductor at a time
Open only the equipment grounding conductor
questions.explanation: The source disconnecting means must simultaneously disconnect all ungrounded conductors from all other conductors.

questions.prompt: Where must the disconnecting means for an interconnected electric power production source be located?
choices: In a readily accessible location
Only on the roof beside the source
Inside a locked utility transformer enclosure
Anywhere on the premises if shown on drawings
questions.explanation: The source disconnecting means is required to be in a readily accessible location.

questions.prompt: A commercial building installs a stationary energy storage system. What equipment-listing requirement applies to the system?
choices: The energy storage system must be listed
Only the battery cells must be listed
Listing is required only when installed outdoors
No listing is required if the system is field assembled
questions.explanation: The NEC requires an energy storage system to be listed.

questions.prompt: A new energy storage system is installed at a commercial telecommunications facility. What must occur when the system is installed?
choices: The system must be commissioned upon installation
The system must remain de-energized for 30 days
Only the serving utility may test the system
Commissioning may be omitted when the system is listed
questions.explanation: Energy storage systems within the rule are required to be commissioned upon installation.

questions.prompt: An energy storage system disconnect is installed within sight of the system. What is the greatest permitted distance between the disconnect and the system?
questions.explanation: A disconnect located within sight of the energy storage system must be no more than 3 m (10 ft) from the system.

questions.prompt: Critical operations power system wiring must be protected against physical damage. Which wiring method is specifically permitted for this protection?
choices: Rigid metal conduit
Open knob-and-tube wiring
Flexible cord run openly
Unsupported nonmetallic cable
questions.explanation: Rigid metal conduit is one of the wiring methods specifically permitted for COPS wiring protected against physical damage.

questions.prompt: How must the capacity and rating of a critical operations power system be sized for the loads it serves?
choices: For all loads expected to operate simultaneously
For only the single largest load
For 50 percent of the connected load
For lighting loads only
questions.explanation: The COPS must have adequate capacity and rating for all loads expected to operate simultaneously.

questions.prompt: A building is supplied by a stand-alone system. What information must the required plaque or directory provide?
choices: The location of each power-source disconnecting means
The monthly energy use of every load
The utility account number
The conductor color code for every branch circuit
questions.explanation: The plaque or directory must denote the location of each power-source disconnecting means for the building or structure.

questions.prompt: How must a stand-alone system be sized for equipment that the user intends to operate at the same time?
choices: Its capacity and rating must be sufficient for all equipment intended to operate simultaneously
It need only supply the largest individual appliance
It must be sized at exactly twice the connected load
Its rating is unrestricted when loads are manually selected
questions.explanation: A stand-alone system must have capacity and rating sufficient for all equipment intended to operate simultaneously.
